note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. FIXED 2026-09-06: `gradeFollowUp`'s isolated-APTT-prolongation branch (R-FU-RECOMMENDED-03, the more specific mixing-studies/factor-work-up recommendation) was dead code — `gradeSeverity` always grades an isolated APTT prolongation 'moderate' via its own R-SEV-MODERATE-02, so the generic `severity === 'moderate'` branch (R-FU-RECOMMENDED-01) was checked first in `gradeFollowUp` and always intercepted before the dedicated branch could ever run. Fixed by reordering the isolated-APTT check ahead of the generic moderate-severity check in both `js/rules.js` and `src/lib/engine/follow-up-rules.ts`, mirroring the same specific-before-generic precedence `gradeSeverity` already uses between R-SEV-MODERATE-02 and R-SEV-MODERATE-01. The `abnormal-isolated-aptt-prolongation-moderate-complete` persona below now correctly fires R-FU-RECOMMENDED-03 (not R-FU-RECOMMENDED-01) and carries the mixing-studies recommendedAction.

personas.name: abnormal-isolated-aptt-prolongation-moderate-complete
